soulUrge:1: Soul Urge 1 in love — Your heart craves a partner who respects your drive and gives you room to stay your own person. A relationship that feels like a cage slowly kills you.
soulUrge:2: Soul Urge 2 in love — Your heart wants deep emotional connection, equal partnership, and the feeling of being understood without having to explain. Healthy romance feels safe enough to be vulnerable.
soulUrge:3: Soul Urge 3 in love — Your heart craves a partner you can laugh with, celebrate life with, and who lets you express yourself fully. A heavy relationship drains your oxygen.
soulUrge:4: Soul Urge 4 in love — Your heart wants steadiness, consistency, and someone reliable. You don't need drama — you need someone who'll still be there tomorrow.
soulUrge:5: Soul Urge 5 in love — Your heart craves a partner who still gives you freedom and a sense of adventure. Domesticated too tightly, you bolt — physically or emotionally.
soulUrge:6: Soul Urge 6 in love — Your heart craves a warm home, someone you can care for, and the feeling of being needed by people you love. This is your most fertile ground.
soulUrge:7: Soul Urge 7 in love — Your heart wants a partner who understands your need for solitude and offers deep intellectual connection. Depth, not constant interaction.
soulUrge:8: Soul Urge 8 in love — Your heart craves a partner who matches your ambition and respects your achievements. A partner without drive feels like dead weight.
soulUrge:9: Soul Urge 9 in love — Your heart craves a partner with a mission or values bigger than just the two of you. You fall for hearts that serve something larger.
soulUrge:11: Soul Urge 11 in love (master) — Your heart craves a partnership that ignites spiritual inspiration both ways. High bar, but when it lands, the relationship is transformative.
soulUrge:22: Soul Urge 22 in love (master) — Your heart craves a partner you can build a real, tangible vision with. Love and life-project become one package.
soulUrge:33: Soul Urge 33 in love (master) — Your heart craves a love that heals and serves. The relationship becomes a vessel for unconditional love that even neighbors feel.
expression:1: Expression 1 in love — You naturally take initiative in the relationship, lead the way, set direction. The challenge: don't run over a softer partner.
expression:2: Expression 2 in love — Your gift is empathy, reading your partner's mood, being their safe harbor. The risk: giving in until your own needs go unheard.
expression:3: Expression 3 in love — Your gift is delighting your partner through humor, creativity, and expressive affection. A relationship without play feels flat to you.
expression:4: Expression 4 in love — Your gift is loyalty, consistency, and building a relationship that lasts. Your romance isn't fireworks — it's a long burn.
expression:5: Expression 5 in love — Your gift is bringing color, variety, and excitement to your partner. But routine pushes you toward escape.
expression:6: Expression 6 in love — Your gift is caring for your partner, building a comforting home, and being a source of stability. People naturally lean on you.
expression:7: Expression 7 in love — Your gift is depth of conversation and reading the emotional layers your partner doesn't name. They feel truly seen by you.
expression:8: Expression 8 in love — Your gift is providing material security and making decisive calls for the partnership. The risk: love feels transactional.
expression:9: Expression 9 in love — Your gift is wide, compassionate love — treating your partner the way you treat the world. The risk: they feel they share you with too many.
expression:11: Expression 11 in love (master) — Your gift is inspiring your partner to become their higher self. The relationship feels like a spiritual calling.
expression:22: Expression 22 in love (master) — Your gift is building a big, tangible shared life: home, kids, joint projects that endure.
expression:33: Expression 33 in love (master) — Your gift is giving love that heals your partner's old wounds. The relationship becomes mutual therapy.
personality:1: Personality 1 in love — First-meet impression: confident, decisive, self-sufficient. Attractive to those who like leaders, intimidating to softer types.
personality:2: Personality 2 in love — Impression: warm, sensitive, easy to approach. People feel safe with you on first contact.
personality:3: Personality 3 in love — Impression: cheerful, expressive, charming. You're the one held in a first glance because the energy is contagious.
personality:4: Personality 4 in love — Impression: grounded, reliable, no-games. Right for those wanting something serious — less attractive to those wanting a fling.
personality:5: Personality 5 in love — Impression: mysterious, fun, free. You spark curiosity, but people sense you're hard to pin down.
personality:6: Personality 6 in love — Impression: warm, nurturing, home-base energy. A magnet for those looking for home, not adventure.
personality:7: Personality 7 in love — Impression: deep, reserved, intriguing. People have to work to break through, but those who do find treasure.
personality:8: Personality 8 in love — Impression: classy, ambitious, capable. A magnet for those seeking a strong partner — can feel transactional to gentler types.
personality:9: Personality 9 in love — Impression: warm and wide, like you welcome everyone. Partners sometimes need to claim their place so they don't feel like one of many.
personality:11: Personality 11 in love (master) — Impression: there's an aura, a sensitivity, like you broadcast something. Magnetic but intense.
personality:22: Personality 22 in love (master) — Impression: solid, influential, someone whose life clearly has direction.
personality:33: Personality 33 in love (master) — Impression: full of care, grounding, healing just by being present. People feel genuinely seen.
lifePath:1: Life Path 1 in love — Your love mission: learn to merge independence with togetherness. The challenge: don't outrun your partner chasing your own vision.
lifePath:2: Life Path 2 in love — Your love mission: become an equal partner without losing yourself. Love is the main arena for your life lessons.
lifePath:3: Life Path 3 in love — Your love mission: learn to share the stage. Creativity and love often pull at each other — the lesson is integrating both.
lifePath:4: Life Path 4 in love — Your love mission: build a relationship that lasts like a structure. The challenge: don't be so rigid your partner feels managed.
lifePath:5: Life Path 5 in love — Your love mission: learn to commit without feeling caged. Love becomes your biggest teacher about real freedom.
lifePath:6: Life Path 6 in love — Your love mission: nurture without losing yourself. This is your main soil — family, relationships, harmony.
lifePath:7: Life Path 7 in love — Your love mission: learn to trust. Your need for solitude often pulls you back from intimacy — the lesson is keeping the door open.
lifePath:8: Life Path 8 in love — Your love mission: marry power with softness. Career often collides with relationship — the lesson is sacrificing neither.
lifePath:9: Life Path 9 in love — Your love mission: learn to receive love, not just give it. You spread thin across many — the lesson is prioritizing the close ones.
lifePath:11: Life Path 11 in love (master) — Your love mission: partnership as a spiritual vessel. High intensity, the partner must be able to hold your frequency.
lifePath:22: Life Path 22 in love (master) — Your love mission: build a legacy together. Love and grand vision merge in your life.
lifePath:33: Life Path 33 in love (master) — Your love mission: relationship as a healing vessel. Your relationships often carry a therapeutic dimension.
personalYear:1: Personal Year 1 in love — A romantic reset. If single, fresh-start opportunities. If partnered, the relationship enters a new chapter.
personalYear:2: Personal Year 2 in love — A year of union and partnership. Quiet conflicts surface for resolution; partnership takes center stage.
personalYear:3: Personal Year 3 in love — A year of fun, social energy, and expression. Many new connections, lots of chemistry — careful of playing loose at the cost of depth.
personalYear:4: Personal Year 4 in love — A year of foundation-building. The relationship gets pulled toward serious work: moving in, proposals, structural repairs.
personalYear:5: Personal Year 5 in love — A year of shake-up and freedom. Weak relationships get tested; healthy ones get fresh air.
personalYear:6: Personal Year 6 in love — The most fertile love year. Marriage, kids, home, romantic responsibility take the stage.
personalYear:7: Personal Year 7 in love — An introspective year. The pull inward can leave a partner feeling distant — conscious communication is key.
personalYear:8: Personal Year 8 in love — Career dominates. Love feels back-burnered — make deliberate time so your partner doesn't feel sidelined.
personalYear:9: Personal Year 9 in love — A year of completion. Relationships that have run their course close; space opens for a fresh start next year.
personalYear:11: Personal Year 11 in love (master) — A spiritual-opening year that often brings a high-vibration partner. Intensity rises.
personalYear:22: Personal Year 22 in love (master) — A year for manifesting a big partnership. Marriage, buying a home, building a family often arrives now.
personalYear:33: Personal Year 33 in love (master) — A love-as-service year. A specific person — child, parent, an ill partner — often calls for caretaking.
bridge:0: Bridge 0 in love — Your inner self and outer self are identical in romantic mode. What you feel reads straight through; your partner rarely has to guess. Small risk: you have little camouflage when you need space.
bridge:1: Bridge 1 in love — Almost no gap between what your heart feels and what you show a partner. Light adjustments — self-awareness usually does it.
bridge:2: Bridge 2 in love — A small gap between inner self and how you present in a relationship. Mostly aligned; the occasional misread can be talked through.
bridge:3: Bridge 3 in love — A real rhythm difference between what you want inside and what you display. A partner is sometimes surprised by sides you don't lead with.
bridge:4: Bridge 4 in love — Moderate gap. What you need inside (e.g., depth) often doesn't match what you show outside (e.g., easygoing). You have to choose to show the real one.
bridge:5: Bridge 5 in love — A real tug between heart and presentation. A partner often gets a version of you that's less than what you actually feel — conscious communication is the work.
bridge:6: Bridge 6 in love — Big gap between inner self and romantic persona. Two sides pull hard; integration makes you a rare partner because you can hold qualities that usually contradict.
bridge:7: Bridge 7 in love — Big distance with an introspection-vs-expression theme. Partners often work hard to get past your wall — the lesson is opening the door more often.
bridge:8: Bridge 8 in love — The widest gap. What your heart feels and what your partner sees can look like two different people. Deepest growth lives here — integrated, you become a fully present partner.
